guard: who labels a manager census the broker refuses to a spawn-scoped user bearer as denied, and still exits 0, ok and complete
command: COTAL_USER_ENDPOINT_CLI_ONLY=1 pnpm --filter cotal-ai... build && COTAL_USER_ENDPOINT_CLI_ONLY=1 pnpm smoke:user-spawn:live
why: The smoke signs an ordinary spawn-scoped user in against a live broker, auth service and manager, where manager.read is refused by the broker. The CLI child runs the built dist, so each mutation rebuilds it and the restore rebuilds it back.
The focused mode runs the same native setup and these assertions, then tears down; the full suite remains the CI-registered coverage.
